name: Erotic Fantasy Camp
source: Arrive at Fantasy Camp for fun and relaxation, only to uncover mysteries that awaken more than curiosity. Build intimate bonds with the camp counsellor and other members as desire, danger, and passion intertwine across every wild corner of nature.
translation: 本想来幻想营地寻欢放松，却意外揭开了唤醒的不止是好奇心的重重谜团。在大自然每一处狂野角落里，当欲望、危险与激情交织缠绕，与营地辅导员及其他营员建立亲密无间的羁绊吧。
